items.title: [正面] I hate gacha business models. I love Morimens. Thi...
items.summary: I hate gacha business models. I love Morimens. This game is so good I don't care that it's a gacha. It's an anomaly of the genre in both quality and generosity. Imagine a surreal cosmic body horror visual novel combined with a card battler and that's what this is. The art is great, the audio is great, and the story and gameplay are great.
